sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO EAI.IF_APPROVAL_HD_XICNA USING DUAL ON (APP_NO = #AppNo#) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET APP_STATUS = #AppStatus# , IF_FLAG = 'N' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (APP_NO,APP_STATUS,IF_FLAG,IF_DATE) VALUES (#AppNo#,#AppStatus#,'N',SYSDATE)

MERGE INTO EAI.IF_APPROVAL_DT_XICNA USING DUAL ON (APP_NO = #AppNo# AND APP_SEQ = #AppSeqField#) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET APP_STATUS = #AppvSt# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( APP_NO ,APP_SEQ ,APP_USER_ID ,APP_EMP_NO ,APP_USER_NM ,DEPT_NM ,POSITION_NM ,DUTYNM ,APP_STATUS ,APP_NOTE ) VALUES ( #AppNo# ,#AppSeqField# ,#AppvId# ,#AppUserIDField# ,#AppvNm# ,#AppOrgIDField# ,#AppvPostnNm# ,#AppDutyNmField# ,#AppvSt# ,#AppvCmmt# )
